strong_signals: exact Git blob or byte-for-byte match to distinctive VOID material
reuse of exact VOID schema or marker identifiers
reuse of the canonical Chain-2050/genesis identity or fingerprint registry while presenting another origin
copied VCL or trademark language with removed or falsified attribution
copied distinctive source comments, tests, schemas, fixtures, proof scripts, receipt shapes, or gate structures
multiple independent distinctive VOID-specific similarities with later chronology
weak_signals: generic blockchain or distributed database concepts
wallets, validators, tokens, payments, markets, or receipts in general
generic proof, CI, recovery, storage, or networking patterns
future_comparison_rules.decision_rule: No automatic accusation. Preserve exact public evidence, establish chronology and ownership/license scope, then require human/legal review.
